name: research-system-root
description: Root configuration to run Express Node server, Flask API server, Flask ML service, and React frontend concurrently

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:ml
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FLASK-API,ML-SERVICE,FRONTEND" -c "blue,yellow,magenta,cyan" "node backend/server.js" "python backend/api.py" "python ml-service/app.py" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
